name: apply_offset_to_linked_entries
description: Subtracts reference words from a three-word position record and adds the resulting delta to the three coordinate words of every entry in a linked list. Entries whose state byte is zero are marked with state value 2.

name: propagate_record_offsets_to_list
description: Adds three offset words from a record to its three coordinate words, then walks a linked list and marks zero-state entries with value 2. It finishes by clearing the top bit of the record's flag byte.

name: reset_bounds_and_process_list
description: Clears the pending-update flag and copies four bounding words from a source table into working copies. It then walks a linked list of entries that lack the flag bit and handles each one, calling the helpers for list updates.

name: update_record_clip_rectangle
description: When a record has its clip-enable bit set, it converts the record's origin and size into a bounding rectangle held in globals, then walks the entry list. It clears the record's pending bit once the list has been processed.

name: insert_and_dispatch_list_states
description: Inserts one entry at the head of a linked list, then walks the list and handles each entry by its state byte: zero is skipped, value 2 and negative states take separate paths. It clears the record's flag when the global flag is negative.

name: store_table_entry_fields
description: Calls a subroutine, then writes a 16-bit link value into a table entry. It also stores two long words, one word and the global state byte at fixed offsets inside that entry.

name: link_entry_at_list_head
description: Links an entry at the head of the list kept in a global head pointer. The entry's link word is copied from its source, the previous head is stored in its back-link field, and the entry becomes the new head.

name: write_table_entry_after_calls
description: Calls two subroutines, copies a link word into a table entry, and writes two long words, one word and the global state byte at fixed offsets. It then makes two more subroutine calls before returning.

name: reset_bounds_to_extremes
description: Sets the four bounding globals to the largest positive and the most negative 16-bit values. Any later bounds update will therefore replace them.

name: expand_global_bounds_with_entry
description: When an entry's flag is non-negative, widens the four global bounding values so they include the entry's rectangle. The rectangle is its origin plus the width and height read from the referenced shape header.

name: insert_entry_sorted_by_keys
description: Walks a linked list to the first node whose sort key (one word, then two byte keys) is not smaller than the given entry's key. It splices the entry in before that node and clears the entry's state byte.

name: update_overlapping_entries
description: Returns at once if the record's clip-skip flag bit is set. Otherwise it walks a linked list, testing each entry for overlap with the current record and calling subroutines for matches, then updates the global state flag and the record's flags.

name: return_undefined_stack_stub
description: Does nothing except return an undefined value read from the stack. The decoder shows a stub with no computation, so it is likely unused filler.

name: copy_bounds_into_table_entry
description: Copies four 16-bit bounding values into the table at the current write pointer, advances the pointer by one four-word record, and calls a subroutine when the pointer reaches the table limit.

name: replay_bounds_records_in_table
description: Walks the table of four-word bounding records from its start up to the current write pointer. It loads each record into the working bounds globals and calls a subroutine for every record.

name: clamp_entry_to_bounds
description: Compares an entry's rectangle with the working bounds globals and returns unchanged when they do not overlap. Otherwise it stores the clamped intersection in the intersection globals and sets the global flag to one.

name: test_overlap_update_bounds
description: Tests whether an entry's rectangle overlaps a reference rectangle taken from the referenced shape. On overlap it narrows the lower bounds, widens the upper bounds and sets the global flag; otherwise it clears the flag.

name: compute_aligned_clip_intersection
description: Initialises the working clip rectangle from an entry when no clip is active. If a second entry overlaps it, computes the intersection, aligns its left edge to sixteen-pixel boundaries and derives a width and a buffer offset.

name: return_without_action
description: Contains only a return instruction, so calling it performs no work.

name: return_without_action
description: Contains only a return instruction, so calling it performs no work.

name: scan_word_table_for_zero
description: Walks a length-prefixed table of words and skips negative entries. It calls a subroutine for each non-negative word and stops early after a call on a word that is nonzero.

name: check_shape_box_within_limits
description: Selects a shape descriptor from a table and checks its flag mask against the current flags. When the mask matches, it computes the shape's bounding box from a base position, mirroring offsets when a flag is set, and returns one only if that box lies inside the global limits.

name: check_fixed_box_within_limits
description: Checks a fixed-layout shape descriptor against a flag mask. When the mask matches, it computes the bounding box from a base position with mirrored offsets if a flag is set, and returns one only when the box lies inside the global limits.

name: check_wide_box_within_limits
description: Checks a shape descriptor that stores full-width offsets against a flag mask. When the mask matches, it computes the bounding box from a base position, mirrors offsets when a flag is set, and returns one only if the box lies inside the global limits.

name: copy_record_into_buffer_reverse
description: Writes a counted record into a buffer from the end backwards. It stores two leading byte values first, then writes the remaining words in reverse order until the counter wraps below zero.

name: search_word_table_for_key
description: Scans a counted table of four-byte entries for a 16-bit key held in a register. It leaves no result behind and only returns, whether the key is found or the table runs out.

name: return_without_action
description: Contains only a return instruction, so calling it performs no work.

name: clear_indexed_entry_byte
description: Calls a subroutine, then, when the index is non-negative, clears one byte inside the table entry selected by that index.

name: clear_status_low_bit
description: Clears the lowest bit of a status byte located 36 bytes below the base pointer, leaving the other bits unchanged.

name: set_status_second_bit
description: Sets the bit with value two in a status byte located 36 bytes below the base pointer, leaving the other bits unchanged.

name: clear_status_second_bit
description: Clears the bit with value two in the same status byte located 36 bytes below the base pointer, leaving the other bits unchanged.

name: store_low_byte_global
description: Calls a subroutine, then copies the byte held in the data register into a global state variable.

name: copy_bytes_to_base_offset
description: Copies a block of bytes from a source record into an area addressed from the base pointer. The destination offset and the byte count both come from the first two words of the record.

name: store_masked_then_set_global
description: Calls a subroutine, stores the low two bits of a register into a global variable, and then overwrites that variable with one.

name: set_pointers_from_global_index
description: Computes a pointer by shifting the global byte left by five bits and adding it to the address of that global. It stores the result in two global pointer variables.

name: update_global_buffer_from_state
description: Clears a state byte, then picks a path from that byte and the sign of the index register. One path copies 64-word global regions onto themselves; the other copies a 16-word entry from a source into two destination buffers and resets several state bytes.

name: forward_to_subroutine
description: Calls one subroutine and returns, passing control onward without changing any values.

name: copy_entry_into_two_buffers
description: When the global state is not one or five and a source word equals minus two, copies a 16-word entry into two destination buffers. A 16-word block from the global area is appended when a count condition holds, then the state bytes are reset.

name: reset_global_state_byte
description: Writes an all-ones byte and then zero twice, leaving a global state byte cleared.

name: store_word_in_indexed_table
description: Calls two subroutines, then, unless the global state byte is one of a few excluded values, stores a register word into a table at an offset given by the index register. It then calls another subroutine.

name: test_low_nibble_sum
description: Adds the low nibbles of two registers and compares the sum with fifteen. Both outcomes return immediately, so the routine leaves no state behind.

name: test_low_nibble_difference
description: Subtracts the low nibble of one register from another and tests the result's range. Every path returns without changing any state.

name: copy_entry_and_update_state
description: Returns early for certain global state values. Otherwise it either re-copies a 64-word global region or, for a matching source entry, copies a 16-word entry into a destination buffer with an optional appended block. It then sets several state bytes from the index value.

name: repack_word_nibble_fields
description: Loops over 64 words and, wherever two words differ, compares their three four-bit fields and calls subroutines to adjust them. It then writes back each changed word, packed from the three resulting nibbles.

name: copy_word_table_with_state
description: Returns early for certain global state values. Otherwise it clears the state byte, copies a counted word table from the source into a destination buffer, optionally appends a 16-word global block, and sets state bytes from the register value.

name: call_one_subroutine_only
description: Calls one subroutine and returns without doing any other work.

name: invoke_single_subroutine
description: Calls one subroutine and returns without doing any other work.

name: add_shape_entry_or_children
description: Sets a working rectangle from global bounds, then either records a new shape entry with its position, flags and offsets, or walks a counted list of child entries. For each child it applies offsets and calls subroutines, and a special marker value takes the buffer-copy path.

name: add_shape_entry_from_offsets
description: Walks a counted list of shape entries when the first word is not the marker value, applying each entry's offsets to the running position and calling subroutines for each one. The marker value instead copies a 16-word entry into buffers, then resets the state bytes.

name: clear_state_if_flagged
description: When a given global value is nonzero and the state byte is not positive, sets the state byte to two and then clears it to zero. Otherwise it returns unchanged.

name: run_calls_clear_state
description: Calls four subroutines in sequence, then clears a global state byte.

name: copy_data_register_value
description: Calls a short subroutine that copies one data register into another, then returns.

name: dispatch_through_offset_table
description: Reads a byte from the source stream and uses it as an index into a table of 16-bit offsets. It then calls the routine at the address that results.

name: swap_pointers_then_dispatch
description: Swaps two global 32-bit values, then calls the routine selected by a byte at the source pointer through a table of 16-bit offsets.

name: copy_null_terminated_string
description: Copies a null-terminated string from the source pointer into the destination global pointer, including the terminating zero byte.

name: return_without_effect
description: Contains only a return instruction, so calling it changes nothing.

name: return_without_work
description: Contains only a return instruction and performs no work before returning.

name: return_immediately
description: Executes a return and performs no other operation or data modification.

name: return_empty_routine
description: Contains no executable work and returns straight away.

name: copy_string_from_offset_table
description: Reads a byte from the source stream, forms an address by adding that byte to the base pointer, and copies the null-terminated string found there into the destination global pointer.

name: compute_weighted_sum_of_words
description: Starts from a seed value and adds the products of two word sequences, one read forward from the source pointer and one walked backwards from a base offset. The count comes from a byte, and the routine returns the accumulated sum.

name: compute_seeded_weighted_sum
description: Calls subroutines twice, the second returning a base offset. It then accumulates products of word pairs for a count held in a byte, starting from the index register doubled plus that base, and returns the sum.

name: compute_weighted_sum_indexed
description: Calls one subroutine first, then accumulates products of word pairs for a count held in a byte, starting from the index register doubled plus a base offset. It returns the resulting sum.

name: accumulate_word_products
description: Repeatedly multiplies a word from the source pointer by a word walked backwards from another pointer, adding each product to a running total. It stops when the counter passes minus one and returns the total.

name: invoke_register_copy_helper
description: Calls a short subroutine that copies one data register into another, then returns.

name: forward_register_copy_call
description: Calls a short subroutine that copies one data register into another, then returns.

name: call_register_copy_helper
description: Calls a short subroutine that copies one data register into another, then returns.

name: compare_registers_after_copy
description: Calls a subroutine that copies one data register into another, then compares two register words. It returns in either case, so it leaves no visible effect.

name: compare_registers_equal_after_copy
description: Calls a subroutine that copies one data register into another, then compares two register words for equality. It returns on both outcomes, so it leaves no visible effect.

name: compare_words_after_copy_less
description: Calls a subroutine that copies one data register into another, then compares two register words. It returns on both outcomes, so it leaves no visible effect.

name: compare_words_after_copy_order
description: Calls a subroutine that copies one data register into another, then compares two register words in the opposite order. It returns on both outcomes, so it leaves no visible effect.

name: compare_words_after_copy_bound
description: Calls a subroutine that copies one data register into another, then compares two register words. It returns on both outcomes, so it leaves no visible effect.

name: compare_words_after_copy_signed
description: Calls a subroutine that copies one data register into another, then compares two register words as signed values. It returns on both outcomes, so it leaves no visible effect.

name: wrap_register_copy_call
description: Calls a short subroutine that copies one data register into another, then returns.

name: delegate_register_copy_call
description: Calls a short subroutine that copies one data register into another, then returns.

name: copy_register_data
description: Calls a short subroutine that copies one data register into another, then returns.

name: store_hash_result_global
description: Calls a subroutine that computes a hash value and stores its 16-bit result in a global variable.

name: compute_linear_hash_word
description: Multiplies the low word of the data register by a fixed constant and adds a fixed offset, returning the resulting 32-bit value. It is a single multiply-and-add mixing step.

name: test_sign_no_effect
description: Tests the data register for zero or a negative sign, then returns on every path, so it has no effect.

name: exit_without_work
description: Contains only a return instruction, so calling it performs no work.

name: call_routine_unless_global_set
description: Returns at once when a global flag byte is nonzero. Otherwise it calls one subroutine and then returns.

name: call_single_routine_direct
description: Calls one subroutine and returns without other work.

name: call_routine_if_global_zero
description: When a global flag byte is zero, calls one subroutine. Otherwise it returns immediately.

name: forward_call_without_test
description: Calls one subroutine and returns with no test beforehand.

name: call_routine_if_global_clear
description: When a global flag byte is zero, calls one subroutine. Otherwise it returns immediately.

name: call_routine_unless_flagged
description: Returns at once when a global flag byte is nonzero. Otherwise it calls one subroutine and then returns.

name: call_register_clearing_routine
description: Calls a short subroutine that clears the data register, then returns.

name: dispatch_selector_value_actions
description: Dispatches on a selector value. The value four walks a global linked list to its end, values 65 to 72 and 97 to 104 call a subroutine, and every other value returns without action.

name: call_subroutine_then_return
description: Calls one subroutine and returns without other work.

name: clear_indexed_global_byte
description: Calls a subroutine, then clears one byte of a global table at an offset given by the low byte of the data register.

name: copy_string_into_global_buffer
description: Copies a null-terminated string from the source pointer into the global destination pointer, including the terminating zero byte.

name: loop_calling_subroutine_forever
description: Calls a subroutine in an endless loop, so it never returns on its own.

name: store_byte_at_word_offset
description: Writes the byte in the data register to the address formed by the base pointer plus a word offset read from the source pointer.

name: store_word_at_word_offset
description: Writes the 16-bit value in the data register to the address formed by the base pointer plus a word offset read from the source pointer.

name: copy_string_to_offset_destination
description: Copies a null-terminated string from a global source pointer to the address formed by the base pointer plus a word offset read from the source pointer.

name: store_byte_at_index
description: Calls a subroutine to obtain an index, then copies the byte read from the source pointer into the base-relative location at that index.

name: store_word_at_returned_offset
description: Calls a subroutine to obtain an offset, then writes the 16-bit word read from the source pointer at the base-relative location.

name: write_byte_at_byte_offset
description: Writes the byte in the data register to the address formed by the base pointer plus a one-byte offset read from the source pointer.

name: write_word_at_byte_offset
description: Writes the 16-bit value in the data register to the address formed by the base pointer plus a one-byte offset read from the source pointer.

name: copy_string_to_byte_offset
description: Copies a null-terminated string from a global source pointer to the address formed by the base pointer plus a one-byte offset read from the source pointer.

name: call_unresolved_routine_once
description: The decompiler timed out, so the body is not recovered. The facts show a single call to one unnamed routine, which was executed in the reference run.

name: add_byte_at_offset
description: Adds the byte in the data register to the byte stored at the base-relative address given by a word offset read from the source pointer, and stores the sum back there.

name: add_word_at_offset
description: Adds the 16-bit value in the data register to the word stored at the base-relative address given by a word offset read from the source pointer.

name: add_word_at_byte_offset
description: Adds the 16-bit value in the data register to the word stored at the base-relative address given by a one-byte offset read from the source pointer.

name: append_global_string_at_offset
description: Scans forward from the address formed by the base pointer and a one-byte offset to the terminating zero byte, then appends a null-terminated string from the global source pointer there.

name: chain_three_subroutine_calls
description: Calls a subroutine to produce a value, passes that value to a second subroutine, then calls a third subroutine with no arguments.

name: build_concatenated_text_string
description: Clears three global values, then copies a source string into a buffer, writing a separator byte when a flag is zero. It appends a second string from a global pointer and terminates the result. The referenced text is DF0: and main.ao.

name: initialize_globals_and_pointer_table
description: Stores fixed initial values into several global variables and an object record. It then fills a table by stepping a counter in fixed steps of 36 and recording the resulting pointers until the table end is reached.

name: copy_name_with_state_suffix
description: Copies a file name into a buffer and replaces the character after its final period with a letter chosen from the global state. It then sets global pointers and counters from table bases before returning.

name: expand_control_byte_stream
description: Repeatedly reads control bytes from a stream and expands them. A byte with its high bit set triggers a counted run of calls, while other bytes drive a second counted loop of calls. The loop has no exit in the decoded form.

name: read_byte_with_refill
description: Returns the byte at the current read pointer. When the pointer has reached the buffer limit, it first calls a subroutine that refills the pointer.

name: write_byte_if_in_range
description: Writes the byte in the data register to a destination computed from a base and an offset. It skips the write when a range check fails and the counter has run out.

name: decode_packed_byte_stream
description: Decodes a packed byte stream into a buffer. Control values select literal runs or back-references, with repeat lengths built from several reads, until the output pointer reaches the end.

name: compute_absolute_byte_difference
description: Returns the first byte when the second byte minus it is not negative. Otherwise it calls a subroutine when a bounds check passes and returns the negated difference.

name: reduce_offsets_by_record_area
description: For a record whose type byte is zero or two and whose height field is nonzero, subtracts the record's area from the offset entries beyond it. It then updates the record's size fields and calls a subroutine. Otherwise it returns zero.

name: reduce_offsets_by_entry_area
description: When an entry's height field is nonzero, subtracts the entry's area from the stored offset entries beyond it. It then resets the entry's size fields and calls a subroutine. Otherwise it returns zero.

name: reduce_offsets_and_clear_entry
description: Subtracts an entry's area from the offset table entries beyond it, marks the entry's size fields as cleared, then calls a subroutine.

name: shift_entries_and_offset_pointers
description: Copies a block of words down a buffer and reduces the buffer's end counter. It then shifts or offsets pointer lists, walks linked record lists, and subtracts a shift amount from each stored pointer that lies beyond a limit.

name: offset_pointers_matching_entries
description: Walks a linked list of entries and compares an identifier to decide whether to process each one. Pointers beyond a limit are reduced by a shift amount, and the routine then updates further pointer lists the same way.

name: offset_pointers_in_entry_list
description: Walks a linked list of entries and, for each entry at or above a limit, subtracts a shift amount from its pointer fields. It then updates secondary pointer lists in the same way.

name: offset_pointers_in_all_lists
description: Walks every entry in the active list and, for each stored pointer lying beyond a limit, subtracts a shift amount from it. Each entry's secondary pointer list is updated the same way.

name: offset_pointers_in_given_list
description: Walks the list of entries reached from the supplied pointers and subtracts a shift amount from each stored pointer lying beyond a limit. It returns its first argument unchanged.

name: find_next_larger_table_entry
description: When a key differs from the record's stored key, scans a table for the smallest entry above a reference value. It then calls a subroutine with that result.

name: call_and_return_stack_value
description: Calls one subroutine and returns an undefined value taken from the stack, adding no data of its own.

name: call_and_return_registers
description: Calls one subroutine and returns the values held in the data registers unchanged.

name: binary_search_word_table
description: Performs a binary search over a table of entries whose leading word is a sorted key. It returns when the key matches or the search range becomes empty, leaving no result behind.

name: initialize_free_list_entries
description: Fills an array of six-byte list entries with increasing offsets and zero values. It then resets the list head to zero and sets two global counters to fixed starting values.

name: insert_object_record_into_list
description: Inserts a pointer into a key-ordered list and advances the list count. When the count is within its limit, it initialises a new object record from the input record's fields and fixed values.

name: initialize_object_record_from_input
description: Takes an entry from a free chain and initialises a new object record from the input record's fields and fixed values. When the list is at capacity it calls a subroutine instead.

name: allocate_or_reclaim_object_record
description: Initialises a new object record from the input when space remains. Otherwise it unlinks an existing entry, shifts the record buffer to reclaim space, and updates flags and bytes of matching linked entries.

name: remove_object_record_entry
description: Looks up an object record by index. When it exists, it compacts the record buffer, adjusts stored pointers beyond it, unlinks the entry and processes matching linked entries. If the record is missing it clears the global flag.

name: evaluate_flag_bits_result
description: Tests bits of its input word and of a second word returned by a subroutine. Depending on the bits it stores inputs into globals, loops over subroutine calls until a condition clears, and returns one of two words.

name: invoke_and_pass_value
description: Calls one subroutine and returns the data register value unchanged.

name: retry_until_nonnegative
description: Repeatedly calls a subroutine until it returns a non-negative value. A second subroutine is called between attempts, and the data register is returned at the end.

name: poll_until_nonnegative_stored
description: Calls a subroutine and stores its result in a global. While the result is negative it calls a second subroutine and tries again, then returns the data register.

name: poll_until_nonnegative_global
description: Calls a subroutine and stores its result in a global. While the result is negative it calls a second subroutine and tries again, then returns the data register.

name: wait_for_nonnegative_result
description: Repeatedly calls a subroutine and, while its result is negative, calls a second subroutine. It returns once the first result is non-negative.

name: repeat_until_nonnegative_call
description: Calls a subroutine, then tests a second call's result and repeats while that result is negative.

name: retry_with_state_until_valid
description: Calls a subroutine and returns its data value once the result is non-negative. While the result is negative, it calls a second subroutine to update state and tries again.

name: loop_until_nonnegative_value
description: Calls a subroutine repeatedly until its result is non-negative, calling a second subroutine between attempts, then returns the data register.

name: loop_until_second_nonnegative
description: Calls a subroutine and keeps its result, then calls a second subroutine and repeats while that second result is negative. It returns the first result.

name: run_state_countdown_actions
description: Steps a global countdown state through a short sequence, calling subroutines at each stage while the state stays positive. It then clears the state.

name: advance_state_with_input_value
description: Advances a global state byte when it is non-negative. On the zero state it calls a subroutine and sets sentinel values. Otherwise it updates the state from an input byte and may call subroutines before clearing the state.

name: decrement_counter_and_accumulate
description: Decrements a counter in a record. While the counter is nonzero it adds a step to a value, clamps the sum to the largest positive 16-bit value and advances a second value. Otherwise it resets the record's fields to fixed values and calls a subroutine.

name: call_four_routines_in_turn
description: Calls four subroutines in sequence and then returns.

name: reset_record_fields
description: Sets one record byte to zero, another to zero, a third to 128, and clears two word fields.

name: step_timed_value_with_counters
description: Advances a value by a step held in a global and clamps the sum to the largest positive 16-bit value. Three counter globals decide whether to advance, and when none applies it calls subroutines and clears the global state.

name: advance_value_with_step_clamp
description: Adds a step to a global value and clamps the sum to the largest positive 16-bit value. It resets the value to a stored bound when that bound is crossed, then decrements a flag and calls two subroutines.

name: decrement_counter_and_call_twice
description: Decrements a global counter and then calls two subroutines in sequence.

name: call_routine_then_clear_flag
description: Calls one subroutine, then clears a global flag byte.

name: report_error_text_and_reset
description: Clears a global flag and calls subroutines that use the referenced text Error. It then sets two status words to fixed values and makes six further subroutine calls.

name: return_with_nothing_done
description: Contains only a return instruction, so it does nothing.

name: add_constant_when_flagged
description: Calls a subroutine and, when its result is nonzero, adds two hundred thousand to a global variable.

name: pass_through_register_pair
description: Calls one subroutine and returns the two data register values unchanged.

name: forward_call_to_routine
description: Calls one subroutine and returns without other work.

name: shift_and_merge_bitplanes
description: Clips a rectangle against bounds, then shifts four bitplane words per column by a sub-word offset. It merges them with a mask into the destination planes and clears a set of state fields when a flag is raised.

name: copy_four_plane_rows
description: Copies sixteen rows of words for four planes from the source table into the destination pointers, stepping each row by fixed strides. The copy is bounded by a global limit.

name: configure_blitter_and_start
description: Computes a destination address from the rectangle globals and programs the blitter's pointer, modulo, mask and size registers. It waits while the busy bit is set and then writes the DMA control register to start the blit.

name: blit_rows_with_wait_loops
description: Loops over a number of rows, programming the blitter's pointer and size registers for each row and waiting for it to finish. It writes the final control value when the loop ends.

name: copy_block_across_plane_pointers
description: Copies a rectangle across four plane pointers with a per-row stride. Rectangles wider than 199 that are not 320 wide are delegated to a subroutine.

name: program_blitter_copy_pass
description: Computes a source offset from the rectangle globals and programs the blitter's size, modulo, pointer and control registers. It waits for the busy bit between writes and then writes the final control value to finish the blit.

name: setup_blitter_masked_line
description: When the record's two flag bits are both clear, programs the blitter's mask, offset and size registers. The control value is chosen by whether a computed value is zero. Otherwise it stores a computed offset in a global variable.

name: copy_clipped_rows_via_lookup
description: Clips a rectangle against the window globals, then copies rows of bytes through a 256-entry lookup table. Rows are read in reverse order when a global flag is clear and forward when it is set, and the blitter registers are used in one path.

name: clip_object_return_status
description: Clips an object's bounding box against the window globals and returns early when it lies outside them. Otherwise it stores the clipped window, computes blitter masks and offsets, and programs the blitter. Several record flag values select different drawing paths.

name: clip_object_and_program_blit
description: Clips an object's bounding box against the window globals and returns without drawing when it lies outside them. Otherwise it stores the clipped window and computes blitter masks and offsets. Several record flag values select alternative drawing paths.

name: release_channel_and_set_mask
description: When the high flag of a channel's status entry is set, clears that entry, sets a flag byte in the channel record and sets a single-bit mask for the channel index. The mask is written to a global value used by the hardware enable register.

name: service_pending_interrupt_bits
description: Calls a subroutine for each of four pending bit flags that are set in a global value. It then writes a fixed control value to the interrupt mask.

name: advance_channel_countdown
description: Decrements a per-channel countdown. When it reaches zero, it clears that channel's fields, copies a stored value into a pointer field and sets the channel's mask for the enable registers. Otherwise it writes the countdown value to the channel's audio volume register.

name: copy_word_to_audio_volume
description: Copies a word from a pointer-offset location into the audio volume register selected by an index.

name: call_routine_four_times
description: Calls one subroutine four times in succession and returns.

name: return_no_operation
description: Contains only a return instruction, so it performs no work.

name: set_flag_or_call_handler
description: When a counter global is nonzero, sets the global flag to one and returns. Otherwise it calls another routine at a fixed address.

name: retain_global_value_only
description: Copies a global variable onto itself twice, which leaves its value unchanged.

name: scale_global_by_fraction
description: Multiplies a global variable by six and shifts the product right by five bits, storing the result back in the global.

name: clear_audio_channel_volumes
description: When a global flag is nonzero, writes zero to the four audio channel volume registers. Otherwise it returns unchanged.

key: captive ii - liberation (1992)(mindscape)[cr dlm](disk 1 of 5)[a3]/Captive II - Liberation (1992)(Mindscape)[cr DLM](Disk 1 of 5)[a3].adf:c/endcli:0:0136
name: copy_sixteen_longs_then_call
description: When a destination pointer is supplied, copies sixteen 32-bit values from a fixed offset in the base block into it. It then calls the code address saved in a register.

key: captive ii - liberation (1992)(mindscape)[cr dlm](disk 1 of 5)[a3]/Captive II - Liberation (1992)(Mindscape)[cr DLM](Disk 1 of 5)[a3].adf:c/Liberation:0:0000
name: follow_link_chain_and_call
description: Program entry point. It follows a chain of links, each scaled by four, from a fixed table until it reaches a zero link, then calls the code address stored in that entry's second field.

key: captive ii - liberation (1992)(mindscape)[cr dlm](disk 1 of 5)[a3]/Captive II - Liberation (1992)(Mindscape)[cr DLM](Disk 1 of 5)[a3].adf:c/Liberation:4:0000
name: scan_hunks_and_clear_cache
description: Scans a sequence of blocks for a four-byte marker. When found, it moves longword data within the block, applies offset corrections to stored addresses and clears the instruction cache through the system library. When the chain ends it frees memory through the library if a version field exceeds 36.

key: captive ii - liberation (1992)(mindscape)[cr dlm](disk 1 of 5)[a3]/Captive II - Liberation (1992)(Mindscape)[cr DLM](Disk 1 of 5)[a3].adf:c/Liberation:4:0104
name: unpack_bitstream_data
description: Decodes a bit-packed compressed stream. Flag bits choose between literal byte copies and back-references with variable-length distances and lengths, and the decoded bytes are written to the output until an end code appears.

key: captive ii - liberation (1992)(mindscape)[cr dlm](disk 1 of 5)[a3]/Captive II - Liberation (1992)(Mindscape)[cr DLM](Disk 1 of 5)[a3].adf:c/delirium:0:0000
name: load_executable_hunks
description: Parses the hunks of an AmigaDOS executable by reading each hunk type code. It allocates memory for code and data hunks, copies their contents, and applies relocation entries that add the load address to stored longwords. It frees memory through the system library when finished.

key: captive ii - liberation (1992)(mindscape)[cr dlm](disk 1 of 5)[a3]/Captive II - Liberation (1992)(Mindscape)[cr DLM](Disk 1 of 5)[a3].adf:c/delirium:0:017C
name: count_down_register_loop
description: Repeatedly decrements a 16-bit count until it passes zero, so it performs a fixed busy-wait with no other effect.

key: captive ii - liberation (1992)(mindscape)[cr dlm](disk 1 of 5)[a3]/Captive II - Liberation (1992)(Mindscape)[cr DLM](Disk 1 of 5)[a3].adf:c/delirium:0:01CC
name: decode_run_length_bytes_backwards
description: Decodes run-length coded bytes into a buffer, filling from a top pointer downwards. Repeat counts are read from the source in several steps until the destination reaches its start.

key: captive ii - liberation (1992)(mindscape)[cr dlm](disk 1 of 5)[a3]/Captive II - Liberation (1992)(Mindscape)[cr DLM](Disk 1 of 5)[a3].adf:c/delirium:0:0218
name: shift_bits_through_buffer
description: Shifts a bit buffer across words, loading a new word when the buffer runs out. Each step accumulates the shifted-out bits into a result word, repeating for a count held in a register.

key: captive ii - liberation (1992)(mindscape)[cr dlm](disk 1 of 5)[a3]/Captive II - Liberation (1992)(Mindscape)[cr DLM](Disk 1 of 5)[a3].adf:c/delirium:0:026C
name: stub_bad_instruction_data
description: Decoded as bad instruction data: a trap and a cache call are followed by a byte update and then an invalid instruction that halts. It is not usable program logic.

name: dispatch_link_chain_entry
description: Program entry point. It follows a chain of links, each scaled by four, from a fixed table until it reaches a zero link, then calls the code address stored in that entry's second field.

name: dispatch_install_link_chain
description: Program entry point. It follows a chain of links, each scaled by four, from a fixed table until it reaches a zero link, then calls the code address stored in that entry's second field.

name: store_pointer_pair_in_struct
description: Library code: writes two 32-bit values from the address registers into a structure addressed by the data register, at offsets 36 and 40.

key: captive ii - liberation (1992)(mindscape)[cr dlm](disk 1 of 5)[a3]/Captive II - Liberation (1992)(Mindscape)[cr DLM](Disk 1 of 5)[a3].adf:libs/math.library:0:00E0
name: decrement_library_counter_and_call
description: Library code: decrements a 16-bit counter in the library's block. When it reaches zero and a flag bit is set, it calls a subroutine and returns that result, otherwise it returns zero.

key: captive ii - liberation (1992)(mindscape)[cr dlm](disk 1 of 5)[a3]/Captive II - Liberation (1992)(Mindscape)[cr DLM](Disk 1 of 5)[a3].adf:libs/math.library:0:00F4
name: finish_or_mark_pending_request
description: Library code: when a counter is zero, reads a value from the request block and makes two library calls through the library base. Otherwise it sets a pending flag bit in the request block and returns zero.

key: captive ii - liberation (1992)(mindscape)[cr dlm](disk 1 of 5)[a3]/Captive II - Liberation (1992)(Mindscape)[cr DLM](Disk 1 of 5)[a3].adf:libs/math.library:0:010E
name: release_request_block_memory
description: Library code: reads a value from the request block, then calls the system Remove and FreeMem routines through the library base to unlink and free it, returning the value.

key: captive ii - liberation (1992)(mindscape)[cr dlm](disk 1 of 5)[a3]/Captive II - Liberation (1992)(Mindscape)[cr DLM](Disk 1 of 5)[a3].adf:libs/math.library:0:013A
name: lookup_word_table_entry
description: Library code: returns the 16-bit entry from a 512-entry table at the index given by the low nine bits of the data register.

key: captive ii - liberation (1992)(mindscape)[cr dlm](disk 1 of 5)[a3]/Captive II - Liberation (1992)(Mindscape)[cr DLM](Disk 1 of 5)[a3].adf:libs/math.library:0:015A
name: transform_point_with_scale_offset
description: Library code: scales a two-word point by a ratio taken from the structure's fields, dividing by the sum of two other fields, then adds offset fields and stores the result in place.

key: captive ii - liberation (1992)(mindscape)[cr dlm](disk 1 of 5)[a3]/Captive II - Liberation (1992)(Mindscape)[cr DLM](Disk 1 of 5)[a3].adf:libs/math.library:0:01A8
name: swap_word_halves_store
description: Library code: swaps the upper and lower 16-bit halves of a register value and stores the result at the address held in the address register.

key: captive ii - liberation (1992)(mindscape)[cr dlm](disk 1 of 5)[a3]/Captive II - Liberation (1992)(Mindscape)[cr DLM](Disk 1 of 5)[a3].adf:libs/math.library:0:01B4
name: scale_point_by_divided_fields
description: Library code: multiplies each of two stored coordinates by a scale field, divides by the sum of a shared field and another field, then adds offset fields. When the divisor is zero, the product is used without division.

name: library_no_op_return
description: Library code consisting only of a return instruction, so it does nothing.

name: return_library_empty_slot
description: Library code consisting only of a return instruction, so it does nothing.

name: return_library_empty_entry
description: Library code consisting only of a return instruction, so it does nothing.

name: split_result_hundreds_remainder
description: Library code: calls a subroutine with an all-ones argument, then returns its value divided by 100 in the upper word and the remainder in the lower word.

key: captive ii - liberation (1992)(mindscape)[cr dlm](disk 1 of 5)[a3]/Captive II - Liberation (1992)(Mindscape)[cr DLM](Disk 1 of 5)[a3].adf:libs/math.library:0:044E
name: update_linear_congruential_state
description: Library code: updates a 16-bit state value with a multiply-and-add step. A non-negative argument first replaces the stored state.

name: build_rotation_matrix_from_angles
description: Library code: looks up sine and cosine style values from a 512-entry table for three angle arguments, then writes a three-by-three matrix of 16-bit values built from products of those values.
